records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net revenue from our semiconductor solutions segment increased primarily due to higher demand for our wireless content in mobile handsets, as well as the delayed production ramp of a new mobile handset by a major customer, which resulted in lower shipments in the prior year fiscal period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: To date, the impact of COVID-19 on the demand environment for our software products has been limited.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Inventory increased to $1,160 million at August 1, 2021 from $1,003 million at November 1, 2020, primarily to support customer demand.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin was $4,197 million for the fiscal quarter ended August 1, 2021 compared to $3,316 million for the fiscal quarter ended August 2, 2020 and $12,206 million for the three fiscal quarters ended August 1, 2021 compared to $9,769 million for the three fiscal quarters ended August 2, 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income from our semiconductor solutions segment increased primarily due to higher demand for our wireless content in mobile handsets, as well as the delayed production ramp of a new mobile handset by a major customer, which resulted in lower shipments in the prior year fiscal period.
